subject.title: feat(ui): docs, help, Discord, and changelog links in the agent chip menu

question: Should the footer agent-chip menu permanently expose Docs, Help, Discord community, and changelog as four separate external destinations?
rationale: This is a new product-chrome navigation choice, and neither existing behavior nor the supplied discussion establishes that this exact destination set and placement is approved.

options.title: Keep all four links
options.body: Approve the destination set, then require viewport-safe placement and real-browser proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the menu
options.body: Retain only the highest-value destinations and route the rest through Help or Docs to reduce menu density.

options.title: Retain Docs only
options.body: Decline the expanded product-chrome surface and keep the existing single external row.

recommendation.title: Keep all four links
recommendation.body: Approve the destination set, then require viewport-safe placement and real-browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history shows direct ownership of the agent-chip footer and utility menu.
